title: Fabrication — chemical vapor deposition
description: Growing films from vapor precursors; the most common mass-production method for graphene. Method class: bottom-up. The nanoscale runs 1–100 nm; a nanometer is a billionth of a meter — about 100,000 times smaller than a human hair’s width.
